newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - ANZ loses funds manager to AMP.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - ANZ loses funds manager to AMP.

text.p: Australia's largest insurance firm, the AMP Society, said on Monday it had appointed Andrew Mohl as general manager, distribution.
Mohl is currently the managing director of ANZ Funds Management, a unit of the Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd.

He will take up his position on November 11. AMP said Mohl, who previously worked for the Reserve Bank of Australia, has a newly created role which gives him responsibility for distribution of retail financial services products other than PriorityOne. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
